hero.title: Beauty that feels like you,
hero.lead: Bridal artistry, luxury hair and skin care, and an ISO-certified academy — all under one roof in Debra.

home.bridalTitle: Your wedding look, crafted with care
home.bridalText: From the first trial to the last photo of the night, Santi and her team create bridal looks that honour tradition and last all day — Bengali chandan saaj, HD or airbrush.
home.servicesText: Thoughtful treatments, premium products and trained hands — for everyday care and your biggest days.
home.academyTitle: Turn your passion into a profession
home.academyText: ISO-certified makeup and beautician courses with hands-on practice on live models, small batches and real career support.
home.ctaText: Message us on WhatsApp — we usually reply within the hour during salon hours.

about.title: Where beauty meets artistry
about.p1: Santi's Makeover & Beauty Salon was founded in 2010 by Santi Dolai with a simple belief: every woman in Debra deserves big-city quality beauty care, close to home.
about.p2: Over fifteen years the salon has grown into Debra Bazaar's trusted destination for bridal makeup, hair and skin care — and an ISO-certified academy that has trained 100+ beauty professionals.
about.p3: We combine time-honoured techniques with modern products and methods, and we never stop learning ourselves.

values.title: Hygiene first
values.text: Sanitised tools, fresh disposables and a spotless space — every time.

values.title: Premium products

values.title: Honest advice
values.text: We recommend what you need, not what costs the most.

values.title: Always learning
